$comment: Ledger for apps/studio/src/vendor. Rule 3 of docs/architecture/vendor.md: every vendored file carries a provenance header and an entry here, so its licence is auditable and a re-copy diff stays possible. `src/vendor/ledger.test.ts` fails the suite if a file in that tree is missing from both lists, or if a header stops agreeing with its entry. `tests/scripts/test_vendor_policy.py` holds every licence to the SPDX ids we may ship and keeps both sections sorted by path, so a refresh diffs as what changed rather than as a reordering. Upstream registry items have no commit, so `integrity` is the sha256 of the artefact fetched from `source` — the handle a refresh diffs against.

components/assistant/thread.tsx.localEdits: only the frame is kept (root, viewport, viewport footer); the message, composer, attachment, markdown, reasoning, and tool-group sections are dropped because Conversation/parts.tsx and ThreadComposer render them, the frame keeps the Studio's classes, the viewport keeps auto-scroll, a float slot carries the jump-to-latest control, and the empty state is a prop rather than derived from the runtime

components/ui/button.tsx.localEdits: the class-merger import moves from the "cn" package to "@/lib/utils"; the six-line header above it is ours

firstParty.boundary.ts: The vendor boundary as data — written here.
firstParty.components/assistant/README.md: Policy summary for the conversation surfaces.
firstParty.components/assistant/questionnaire.tsx: Questionnaire surface: one labelled, accessible field per question kind (statement/text/scale). Authored locally for the interview card (#396); no upstream artefact was fetched in this environment.
firstParty.components/ui/hover-card.tsx: Hover-card primitive: a focusable trigger reveals portal content on hover, focus, or Enter/Space; closes on Escape returning focus to the trigger and on blur. Authored locally for the claim-citation surface; no upstream artefact was fetched.
firstParty.index.css: Tailwind v4 scoped to this tree only; the `source(none)` and `@source` reasoning is ours, not the registry's.
firstParty.lib/utils.ts: Three-line class merger over clsx and tailwind-merge. Not a copy-in: no provenance header arrived with it and it imports only declared npm packages.
